rules.statement: A stranger who enters into possession of the entirety of co-owned property in the belief that he is the sole owner need not prove ouster or something equivalent to ouster but only adverse possession for a period of 10 years in order to acquire a prescriptive title to it.
rules.supporting_quote: "In the present case P2 of 1947 conveyed the entirety of the land to Alutgedera Heen Menika who was a complete stranger and she had entered into possession in the belief that she was the sole owner. In fact the vendor himself had purchased the entirety of the land on P1 in 1946 before conveying it to her. There is nothing to indicate that Heen Menika had any knowledge or belief that any other party had interests in the property at the time she entered the land."

meta.parties: Marshall Appuhamy and Another v. Punchi Banda
